name: pixel-crew
description: Tiny pixel creatures that show what your tasks, debug sessions and terminal commands are doing.

commands.title: Pixel Crew: Make someone say something
Pixel Crew: Toggle status bar buddy

pixelCrew.statusBar.description: Show a walking buddy in the status bar while something runs.

pixelCrew.watchTerminal.description: One creature per command running in a terminal (needs shell integration).

pixelCrew.boss.description: A boss creature that reports git status and problems.

pixelCrew.stateFile.description: Optional crew JSON file (absolute or workspace-relative) whose creatures join the crew. Watched for changes.

pixelCrew.stateUrl.description: Optional URL returning crew JSON (for example http://localhost:4321/state from `pixel-crew serve`). Polled every few seconds.
